title: GPT-6.1 Sol: Near-Flagship AI At One Fifth The Price
description:
OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol costs $2 in / $10 out per million tokens - one fifth of GPT-6 Astra's $10 / $50. The catch: the benchmark claims are OpenAI's own, and Sol isn't in regular ChatGPT chat yet. #Shorts #ai #openai
